Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring applicants for state purchased health care benefits or uncompensated hospital care to identify the employer of the proposed beneficiary of the benefits or care.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health care services; adding new sections tochapter 70.14 RCW; and adding new sections to chapter 43.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any applicant for state purchased health care benefits underchapter 74.09 or 70.47 RCW shall identify the employer or employers ofthe proposed beneficiary of the health care benefits. In the event theproposed beneficiary is not employed, the applicant shall identify theemployer or employers of any adult who is responsible for providing allor some of the proposed beneficiary's support. As used in this section, "proposed beneficiary" means any personwho files an application for benefits for himself or herself; or anyother person on whose behalf an application is filed, including, butnot limited to, children or other dependents of the applicant or otherindividual for whom the application is filed.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person requesting uncompensated care in a hospital shall identifythe employer or employers of the proposed beneficiary of the healthcare services. In the event the proposed beneficiary is not employed,the person shall identify the employer or employers of any adult who isresponsible for providing all or some of the proposed beneficiary'ssupport. As used in this section, "proposed beneficiary" means any personwho seeks uncompensated care for himself or herself; or any otherperson on whose behalf uncompensated care is requested, including, butnot limited to, children or other dependents of the person for whom therequest is made.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: On or before February 1st of each year, the department of socialand health services and the health care authority shall provide theappropriate committees of the senate and house of representatives areport listing all employers identified through the applicationrequirements of section 1 of this act. The report must include eachcompany name, location, and the total number of their employees anddependents who are enrolled in each state funded health care program.No other information regarding program beneficiaries may be included inthis report. The report must also be made available to the public.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: On or before February 1st of each year, the department shallprovide the appropriate committees of the senate and house ofrepresentatives a report listing all employers identified under section2 of this act. The report must include each company name, location,and the total number of their employees and dependents who requesteduncompensated care at a hospital. No other information regardingpersons seeking uncompensated care in a hospital may be included inthis report. The report must also be made available to the public.
